breakdown.description: reactingFoam requires psi-based thermo (hePsiThermo/rhoPsiThermo), not incompressible heRhoThermo
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to correct the thermodynamics package. The original prompt incorrectly specified `heRhoThermo`, which is for incompressible flows and incompatible with the `reactingFoam` solver. The ground truth corrected this to `hePsiThermo`, which is a compressible, psi-based thermo model required by the solver. The generated specification repeated the original error, stating 'Use the heRhoThermo thermodynamics package.'
